messages.subject: Trouble running shiny on a Chromebook?
parts:
I can run a Shiny app that is available on the web, but I can't run it within RStudio using the <source> button.

The server and UI appear to start but I don't see the UI. Something obvious, I'm sure, but ...

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Trouble running shiny on a Chromebook?
parts: I'm guessing Chrome's pop-up blocker is getting in the way. Look for an icon in the URL bar indicating that a pop-up has been blocked, there should be an option to unblock for the domain.
